annotations.title: Create a venue for an owner

description: Creates a draft venue for a business owner. Returns the booking page address, an access key for that venue, the venue’s own MCP address, and a claim link. The venue opens to customers only after the owner claims it with a code sent to their email; unclaimed drafts are deleted after 14 days.

address.description: Optional wanted address, the "name" in name.bookare.app. Default: made from the business name.

agent_name.description: Who is setting it up, e.g. "Claude for Acme Web Studio". Shown to the owner when claiming.

business_type.description: Kind of business: gym, salon, restaurant, hotel, camping, rental or stay.

country.description: Two-letter ISO code, e.g. GR. Sets the prices of the plans.

language.description: Main language of the venue’s pages. Default el for GR and CY, else en.

name.description: Business name as customers know it.

owner_email.description: The owner’s real email: they confirm the claim with a code sent there.
